description.cmn_hans_cn: 获取申万（sw）行业每日的融资融券数据。可按行业代码批量查询返回每日行业融资买入金额、融资偿还金额、融资净买入金额、融资余额、融券卖出金额、融券偿还金额、融券净卖出金额、融券余额等数据。当用户想了解申万（sw）行业每日的融资融券余额以及变动情况、观察杠杆资金进出节奏或分析做空力量时，调用此接口。
description.en: Fetch time-series margin trading data for SW (legacy) industry indices, returning daily financing/securities balances and their market cap ratios within a date range. Returns chronological records. Used when tracking leverage fund flows in SW legacy industries, analyzing sector-level margin sentiment, or backtesting margin-based sector timing signals.
